title: ZEUS HELIOS Service Guide
content:
ZEUS HELIOS Service Guide · Page 1
Section 1: Service levels
The HELIOS standard subscription includes business-day support from 08:00 to 18:00 UTC. The regulated subscription includes 24x7 support. Severity 1 cases receive an acknowledgement within 30 minutes; the support clock pauses while ZEUS waits for information requested from the customer. These service levels supplement the product terms in zeus-product-guide, Section 2. A customer may open a case in the HELIOS console or by telephone using the support number on the order form.

ZEUS HELIOS Service Guide · Page 2
Section 2: Data export and retention
A workspace administrator can export telemetry as compressed CSV from the console. A standard-plan export covers up to 400 days and a regulated-plan export covers up to 1,460 days, subject to the retention settings in zeus-product-guide, Section 2. Export jobs containing more than 50 GB are split into numbered files and retained for 7 days. Deleted workspaces enter a 14-day recovery window; after that window, their telemetry is removed from active storage and scheduled backups.
